title: Design System: Practical Work, Clearly Built

shadows.name: surface
shadows.purpose: Soft separation for raised content in light mode.

shadows.name: surface-dark
shadows.purpose: Quiet tonal depth for raised content in dark mode.

motion.name: card-lift
motion.purpose: Subtle hover feedback, removed when reduced motion is preferred.

motion.name: theme-transition
motion.purpose: Keeps the persisted theme switch visually continuous.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Tightens gutters and stacks the technical focus rows.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Expands the featured project into a two-column evidence layout.

components.name: Primary action
components.refersTo: Hero and contact calls to action
components.description: Teal action with ample touch height and clear keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-action { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); font: 600 0.9rem/1.25 var(--font-body, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-action:hover { background: var(--accent-strong); } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Project card
components.description: Evidence-led project surface with a restrained category accent.
components.html:
CAPSTONE · ROBOTICS

AGROSENTINEL

Project details and contributions from the portfolio source.
components.css: .ds-project { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-top: 2px solid var(--brick-blue); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--bg-raised); color: var(--text-main); box-shadow: var(--shadow-block); } .ds-project__category { margin: 0 0 12px; color: var(--brick-blue); font: 600 0.8rem/1.3 var(--font-body, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-project h3 { margin: 0; color: var(--text-heading); font: 650 1.35rem/1.25 var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-project h3 + p { margin: 10px 0 0; color: var(--text-muted); font: 400 0.95rem/1.6 var(--font-body, sans-serif); }

components.name: Skill row
components.description: Open list row with supporting context and no nested tile styling.
components.css: .ds-skill { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 12px 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-main); font: 400 0.9rem/1.45 var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-skill strong { color: var(--text-heading); font-weight: 600; } .ds-skill span { color: var(--accent); font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-skill p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.86rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Technical focus list
components.description: Compact text-first summary of the documented technical areas.
components.css: .ds-focus { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-focus li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(7rem, 1fr); gap: 12px; padding: 14px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-focus strong { color: var(--text-heading); font: 600 1rem/1.4 var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-focus span { color: var(--text-muted); font: 400 0.88rem/1.45 var(--font-body, sans-serif); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Concise links with a quiet monogram and theme-aware surfaces.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; min-height: 64px; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 10px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-main); color: var(--text-muted); font: 500 0.9rem/1.3 var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible { color: var(--accent); } .ds-nav__mark { display: grid; width: 34px; height: 34px; place-items: center; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); font: 700 0.7rem/1 var(--font-code, monospace); }

narrative.overview: This portfolio should read like a considered introduction to an early-career engineer: direct, calm, and grounded in documented projects. A subtle modular structure connects software, data, IoT, and systems work without turning the interface into a toy or an operations dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Slate and white surfaces with one clear teal action color
Dark mode uses deep navy and raised slate surfaces
Open layouts, thin dividers, and compact evidence groups
Real project and experience details lead over decoration

rules.name: The Evidence First Rule
rules.body: Let documented projects and responsibilities establish the portfolio's credibility.

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: Use accent color to guide attention, not as a page-wide decoration.

rules.name: The Readable Detail Rule
rules.body: Keep important project and experience information available in clear, scannable groups.

dos: Do preserve theme persistence, visible focus, semantic controls, and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't introduce unsupported project claims, metrics, technologies, screenshots, or links.
Don't use circuit-board graphics, cyberpunk effects, generic SaaS gradients, or excessive card decoration.
